one-sided-limit.def: The limit as $x$ approaches $a$ from one side only: $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$ uses $x < a$ (left-hand limit) and $\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$ uses $x > a$ (right-hand limit).

limit-dne.def: A limit does not exist (DNE) when the outputs do not close in on one number: the one-sided limits differ, the outputs grow without bound, or they oscillate.

unbounded.def: Outputs that grow larger and larger in size without any bound, as near a vertical asymptote. Oscillating behavior is outputs that keep swinging between values and never settle.
